scope: Arbitrary dependent three-dimensional laws only; this is not a counterexample to the independent-product QFORM target.
statement: Joint/pair/scalar density caps plus any finite or infinite collection of negative-moment/small-tail bounds for the full two-Jacobian J_2(Y,Q) do not by themselves bound an indefinite quadratic pushforward. Applying account02/B11 r13's shell to F_epsilon=epsilon U^2-epsilon^{-1}Y^2+V^2 gives J_2(Y,F)=2 sqrt(epsilon^2 U^2+V^2)>=2 sqrt(epsilon)R, hence E J_2^{-p}<=(2 sqrt(epsilon)R)^{-p} for all p>0, while p_F>=sqrt(2/3)/delta on [-delta,0]. At epsilon=1/4,R=2 delta^{-2}, all negative moments tend to zero while ||p_F||_infinity grows at least as sqrt(2/3)/delta.
implication: The remaining LDL two-sheet proof must spend original-coordinate product provenance before dependence-blind coarea, marginal, X-ray, or Jacobian-moment envelopes.
